prior_knowledge: Same critic previously read Wish and concept. These are fresh visual observations before updated source/evidence, not a new naive or unprimed review. Round-1 failure remains unchanged.
held_object_and_form: A thick golden circular sunlike game board, central round plateau, radial lanes, cream and brown low extruded counters, two open cylindrical cups and two cream pip dice. Board signature and spatial arrangement remain coherent.
subjects_recognized: Cream counters now read as curved elongated drops: broad rounded leading bulb blends continuously into a swept taper with a rounded end. Dark counters read as broad flowing drops with a shallow notched tail end. The former rabbit-ear outline is materially reduced: long separate projections no longer rise directly from a head, and instead the main body flows into a shared broad taper. With my prior knowledge, comet-like flowing matter is the stronger reading in the detail view. Small upright silhouettes in the action panel retain a weak two-nub creature association, but it is no longer the dominant detailed shape reading.
action_state_difference: One cream counter leaves an upper row, replaces a lower dark counter, and that dark counter moves to the center. Capture/displacement remains plainly visible.
spatial_relationship: Counter files radiate between fine wedge marks. Center is empty before capture and supports a recognizable game counter afterward, with no extra crest blocks. Cups flank the board; dice lie below it. No evident part intersections or floating components.
dice: Dark circular pips are clearly visible in canonical overview. Opposite-view detail exposes all six pip counts, with conventional layouts. Recess depth is not reliably measurable from this rendering alone.
counter_details: Both bodies and tips are rounded, with planar tops and vertical sidewalls. Brown tail is clearly notched into two short rounded terminal branches in top view; split is much shallower than round 1. Brown tail remains broad and only modestly swept, less fluid than cream, but the common flowing trunk is now visible. It does not read as a generic polygon or an actual implement fork.
finish_desirability: Warm palette, sunlike silhouette and coordinated droplet pieces make a coherent appealing tabletop set. Shape repair improves thematic consistency. Clean cups and large center remain visually plain; visible tessellation on counter sidewalls and faint lane lines make the renders look like CAD previews rather than polished photography. Those presentation limitations do not erase the appealing overall object. Missing heading glyphs are fixed.
uncertainties: Absolute dimensions, minimum neck widths, stack handling, full lane capacity, physical stability and die fairness cannot be established visually. Prior target knowledge limits semantic-recognition independence; no claim of fresh naive confirmation is made.
